_note: 英語島文法分區（最後一批）：比較句的省略與平行（eng.t_adv.adjadv.comparison-ellipsis，學測級）。than/as...as 後常省略重複的字；留下的助動詞要與前面動詞平行一致（than I do / than he does）；as...as 後同理。刻意避開把 than I / than me 當單選爭議（兩者在不同語域皆可），改考助動詞一致與重複省略。形式依 Swan/Cambridge，provisional，待英語母語 reviewer 複核。text-only shadowing、無音檔。

units.title_zh: 比較句的省略與平行（than I do）
units.can_do: 我能在 than 和 as…as 之後省略重複的字，並讓留下的助動詞和前面的動詞平行一致：She reads more than I do；He runs faster than his brother does；This test is not as hard as the last one。
units.situation_group: 形容詞與副詞 Adjectives & adverbs
units.subject: eng

claims.text: After 'than' or 'as ... as', we usually leave out the repeated words. Instead of saying everything again, we often keep just an auxiliary: 'She runs faster than I run.' -> 'She runs faster than I do.'
claims.verification_ref: than/as...as 後省略重複字，常只留助動詞（than I do）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The auxiliary that is left must match the first verb in person and tense: 'She works harder than he does' (not 'than he do'); 'I have read more than she has.'
claims.verification_ref: 留下的助動詞要與前動詞人稱/時態平行一致（than he does / than she has）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'as ... as' works the same way, and the second 'as' is still needed: 'This test is not as hard as the last one.'
claims.verification_ref: as...as 同理、第二個 as 不可省（not as hard as the last one）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: We do not repeat the same adjective or verb after the clause. Instead of 'She is taller than I am tall', we say 'She is taller than I am.'
claims.verification_ref: 不重複同一形容詞/動詞：不說 than I am tall，說 than I am；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: After 'than' or 'as ... as', we usually do not repeat the whole verb. We often keep just an auxiliary: 'She runs faster than I run.' becomes 'She runs faster than I do.'
teach.zh_hint: 在 than 或 as…as 之後，我們通常不把整個動詞再講一次，常常只留一個助動詞：She runs faster than I run. → She runs faster than I do.（她跑得比我快。）

teach.body: The auxiliary you keep must match the first verb. If the first verb is present and third person, use 'does': 'She works harder than he does' (not 'than he do').
teach.zh_hint: 你留下的助動詞要和前面的動詞一致。前面是現在式第三人稱，就用 does：She works harder than he does.（她比他更努力。）不是 than he do。

teach.body: My sister reads more books than I do. He has travelled more than she has.
teach.zh_hint: 我姊姊讀的書比我多（I do）。他旅行的次數比她多（she has，前面是 have/has travelled）。助動詞和前面動詞平行一致。

teach.body: 'as ... as' works the same way, and you must keep the second 'as': 'This test is not as hard as the last one.' Also, do not repeat the same adjective: say 'She is taller than I am', not 'than I am tall'.
teach.zh_hint: as…as 也一樣，而且第二個 as 不能省：This test is not as hard as the last one.（這次考試沒上次難。）另外，同一個形容詞不要重複：說 She is taller than I am，不要說 than I am tall。

teach.body: He is as tall as his brother is. Today is not as cold as yesterday.
teach.zh_hint: 他和他哥哥一樣高（as tall as…is）。今天沒有昨天冷（not as cold as…）。

practice.stem: 選正確的助動詞（和 I 平行）：My sister reads more books than I ____ .

distractor_rationales.does: does 是第三人稱；主詞是 I，要用 do。
distractor_rationales.am: 前面的動詞是 reads（一般動詞），省略後要用 do，不是 be 動詞 am。
distractor_rationales.have: 前面不是完成式（沒有 have read），所以不用 have，用 do。

practice.feedback: 和 I＋一般動詞平行：than I do。

practice.stem: 選正確的助動詞（和 his brother 平行）：He runs faster than his brother ____ .

distractor_rationales.do: his brother 是第三人稱單數，要用 does，不是 do。
distractor_rationales.is: 前面是 runs（一般動詞），省略後用 does，不用 be 動詞 is。
distractor_rationales.can: 句中沒有 can；要和 runs 平行，用 does。

practice.feedback: 和第三人稱＋一般動詞平行：than his brother does。

practice.stem: 填入正確的字：This test is not as hard ____ the last one.

distractor_rationales.than: as…as 的結構用 as，不用 than；than 是用在比較級（harder than）。
distractor_rationales.so: not so…as 偏舊式，現代英語一般用 not as…as，這裡第二個空要 as。
distractor_rationales.like: like 不用在 as…as 結構裡。

practice.feedback: as…as 結構，第二個空也用 as：not as hard as the last one。

practice.stem: 選正確的助動詞（和 I have visited 平行）：She has visited more countries than I ____ .

distractor_rationales.has: has 是第三人稱；主詞是 I，完成式要用 have。
distractor_rationales.do: 前面是現在完成式（has visited），省略後要用 have，不是 do。
distractor_rationales.did: 前面不是過去簡單式，要和 have visited 平行，用 have。

practice.feedback: 和 I＋現在完成式平行：than I have。

practice.stem: 'She is taller than I am tall.' 哪一句最自然、沒有多餘重複？
practice.answer: She is taller than I am.
options: She is taller than I am.
She is taller than I am tall.
She is more tall than I.
She is taller than me am.

tall 已在 taller 裡出現，不需再重複；多餘的 tall 要省掉。
tall 是短形容詞，比較級是 taller，不用 more tall。
me 是受格，不能當 am 的主詞；若要留助動詞要說 than I am。

practice.feedback: 省掉重複的 tall、保留助動詞：She is taller than I am。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀練習（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：出聲讀句子，注意 than I do、than he does、as…as 連著唸順；一邊讀一邊想「留下的助動詞有沒有和前面的動詞一致」。

lines.text: My sister reads more books than I do every month.
This test is not as hard as the last one was.
